string-array.item: Why do programmers confuse Halloween and Christmas? Because 31 OCT = 25 DEC.
What do you call a boomerang that doesn\'t come back? A stick.
A guy walks into a bar... and says "Ouch!"
What does a programmer say when they get a flash drive for their birthday? Thanks for the memory!
Two muffins are in an oven. One says, "It\'s hot in here." The other says, "Wow, a talking muffin!"
